title: Exclude arbitrary linear recoding across the helper-572 seam (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped mathematical obstruction with an exact finite boundary certificate. No new kappa.

```diff
 helper 572 overwritten after event 13637 of selected PR6030
- PR6088: two added ADDs cannot repair the declared chart-595/603 seam
+ arbitrary finite rational linear bank recoding cannot repair that seam
```

Six protected output equations force the single transported form to recover the displaced original helper value. It therefore cannot also carry the new independent input. This permits temporary changes to original-input rows and removes the scalar-operation-count bound. The prefix, two correction regions, one transferred field, owned lifetimes and suffix remain fixed.

The new result was produced by Nick Petalas. JoyboyBrian retains PR6088's seam/question and bounded exclusion; apoursh PR6067, Jonathan Capalbo PR6069 and JosieElliston PR6108 retain the carrier/information/cross-time lineage. Credit PR6040/5994/5718, Ali Romman, DreamingOfClouds and all retained P104 predecessors. No predecessor census or exclusion theorem is rerun as this contribution.

## Evidence

Before, arbitrary-length corrections that change original rows were outside PR6088's two-ADD result. After, PROOF.md proves failure for arbitrary 6-by-6 and 3-by-3 bank maps, including singular maps, through a single transported scalar.

The source-bound checker establishes eight independent input forms with minor determinant `1/32`, a six-protected-output minor with determinant `8`, all original-input boundary identities, both exceptional suffix columns at every public output, and the frozen chronology. It enumerates 722 small-field rank-one products, accepts a two-channel scope control, and rejects a singular minor, four changed seam/original-input fixtures and changed source bytes. These finite checks support the written unbounded-length theorem.

Local CPython 3.12.15/macOS arm64, standard library only:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/p104-unrestricted-572-seam/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/p104-unrestricted-572-seam/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-unrestricted-572-seam
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-unrestricted-572-seam --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Both registered checks pass and each completes in under one second locally, against separate 60-second limits. Expected marker: `PASS_P104_UNRESTRICTED_572_SEAM`. Committed bytes, modes and source history pass for the six package files and sole live word input. The official seven-payload-file export passes integrity/input checks. Normal and optimized direct replays also pass in a read-only, Git-free export, produce identical generated hash-bound receipts, and preserve all eight exported files and their modes.

Scientific base: canonical main `a5bff3bf133e482541c09eba4e773884bdb2b1b7`, refreshed before commitment and unchanged. The source-binding baseline passes and resolves the selected conditional kappa to `.003125804`. Live open/account PRs, merged/main searches and local reservations found no same-scope target within the recorded coverage. Remote overlap pagination is complete; sparse local-note coverage is explicitly incomplete.

## Limitations

Only homogeneous rational linear recoding within the declared two regions is covered. A second independent transfer, later correction window, pre-cut save, new storage, nonlinear encoding or another word may change the conclusion. No physical/native supplier, complete paid/target invoice, normalization or multiplication theorem is claimed. No selected scientific cold/native/compiler/caller/outer replay, Lean or Docker check was run. All five selected framework assumptions remain. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

1. Specify a second legal transferred form, solve its complete arbitrary-input endpoint equations, and price its frames, restoration and full signed invoice.
2. Pin one changed cut or pre-cut save with its owned lifetime and determine whether its new protected-output minor still creates a one-channel deficit.

## Related open work

- #5606 constructs a prepared P104 split-helper reuse; this theorem excludes only the named frozen two-region alternative on selected PR6030.
- #5553 proposes successor P104 interfaces; their changed words and conditional prices are outside this seam certificate.

The completion refresh listed this account's currently open PRs and found none created since the advance CLAIM at 2026-10-29 22:13:51 UTC. A live repository open-PR scan found no other submission studying this exact helper-572 two-chart boundary. The broader P104 and frame results listed at publication are no longer open in the completion scan. No competing same-instance endpoint value was identified; no additional computations were run to compare other contributions. The immediate predecessors #6088/#6067/#6069/#6108 are merged. Archival merging does not establish scientific acceptance.
